note: Recorded sample output for demos and tests, written for the invoice-reconciliation sample brief.

journeys.goal: Clear the month's exceptions before the close deadline

actions: Exports invoices, purchase orders and bank payments as CSV
painPoints: Exports have bad rows that break a whole spreadsheet
opportunities: Check every row and import the good ones; list rejected rows with reasons

actions: Filters by type or sorts by amount
opportunities: Only exceptions in the queue; matched items one step away

actions: Chooses a resolution and writes a note
opportunities: Evidence side by side with differences labelled
Note kept with the resolution in the audit trail

painPoints: Losing their place in a long list
opportunities: Go straight to the next exception from the keyboard

journeys.goal: Approve resolutions with confidence and close the period

actions: Reads the resolution, note and evidence
painPoints: Approving from a spreadsheet without context
opportunities: Everything needed to decide on one screen

actions: Approves, or sends back with a comment
painPoints: Being asked to approve their own work
Not knowing why something was matched
opportunities: Each match names its rule, fields compared and tolerance

actions: Exports the audit trail for the period
painPoints: Assembling evidence for the auditor by hand
opportunities: One export with every event and its evidence

flows.name: Import a month of data
flows.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  A[Import files] --> B[Choose CSV files and period]
  B --> C{Files readable?}
  C -->|No| D[Say which file and why] --> B
  C -->|Yes| E[Check every row]
  E --> F{All rows valid?}
  F -->|Some rejected| G[Import valid rows and list rejected rows with reasons]
  F -->|Yes| H[Import complete]
  G --> I[Match automatically]
  H --> I
  I --> J[Exceptions queue]
steps: Choose the invoice, PO and payment CSV files and the period

flows.name: Resolve an exception
flows.trigger: An invoice couldn't be matched automatically
flows.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  A[Exceptions queue] --> B[Exception detail]
  B --> C{Evidence loaded?}
  C -->|No| D[Error with Try again] --> B
  C -->|Yes| E[Compare invoice, PO and payment]
  E --> F[Choose resolution and write note]
  F --> G{Resolution and note given?}
  G -->|No| H[Say what is missing] --> F
  G -->|Yes| I[Submit for approval]
  I --> J{Saved?}
  J -->|No| K[Keep entries and offer Try again] --> I
  J -->|Yes| L[Sent for approval]
  L --> M[Next exception]
steps: Open the next exception from the queue
Compare the evidence side by side
Choose a resolution and write a note

flows.name: Approve a resolution
flows.trigger: A resolution is waiting for approval
flows.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  A[Approvals] --> B{Has Reviewer role?}
  B -->|No| C[Explain how to get the role]
  B -->|Yes| D[Read resolution, note and evidence]
  D --> E{Proposed by me?}
  E -->|Yes| F[Approval blocked: another reviewer must approve]
  E -->|No| G{Agree?}
  G -->|Yes| H[Approve resolution]
  G -->|No| I[Send back with comment]
  H --> J[Recorded in the audit trail]
  I --> J
steps: Read the resolution, note and evidence
Approve it, or send it back with a comment

flows.name: Check why something was matched
flows.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  A[Matched] --> B[Select a match]
  B --> C[See rule, version, fields compared and tolerance]
  C --> D{Agree?}
  D -->|Yes| E[Mark as checked]
  D -->|No| F[Unmatch and review]
  F --> G[Exceptions queue]
  E --> H[Recorded in the audit trail]
steps: Read which rule matched it and the values compared
Mark it as checked, or unmatch it

flows.name: Export the audit trail at close
flows.trigger: The period is ready to close
flows.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  A[Exceptions: none open] --> B[Audit trail]
  B --> C[Choose period and format]
  C --> D[Export audit trail]
  D --> E{Export created?}
  E -->|No| F[Error with Try again] --> D
  E -->|Yes| G[Download export]

screens.name: Exceptions
screens.purpose: The home screen: every invoice that couldn't be matched automatically, for the selected period, ready to work through.
keyContent: Period summary: open exceptions, matched automatically, waiting for approval, value in exceptions
Filters by exception type and search
Queue of exceptions with invoice, supplier, reason, amount and age
Keyboard shortcuts hint

states.description: Queue of open exceptions with the period summary
No open exceptions for the period
Some rows from the last import were rejected, so the queue may be incomplete

screens.name: Exception
screens.purpose: Resolve one exception: see the invoice, purchase order and payment side by side, understand why it was flagged, and propose a resolution.
keyContent: Why this is an exception, naming the rule and the values
Invoice, purchase order and bank payment side by side
Differences labelled in words
Resolution choice and note for the reviewer

states.description: Evidence couldn't load, or the resolution couldn't be sent

statesNotNeeded.reason: Only opens for a specific exception, which always has an invoice.

screens.name: Matched
screens.purpose: Review what was matched automatically or by a reviewer, and why.
keyContent: Matched sets: invoice, purchase order and payment
Filter by rule
Why the selected set was matched: rule, version, fields compared, tolerance
Mark as checked, or unmatch

states.description: Matched sets with the explanation for the selected one

screens.name: Approvals
keyContent: Resolutions waiting, with who proposed them
Selected resolution: what, why, evidence and note
Approve, or send back with a comment
Self-approval is blocked

states.description: Resolutions couldn't load, or the approval couldn't be saved
Signed-in person doesn't have the Reviewer role

screens.name: Import files
screens.purpose: Bring in invoices, purchase orders and bank payments for a period from CSV files.
keyContent: Three file slots: invoices, purchase orders, bank payments
Accounting period
Column mapping
Row checks and results

states.description: A file couldn't be read or the import stopped
Some rows were rejected; the rest were imported

statesNotNeeded.reason: The file picker is this screen's starting state; there is nothing to be empty.

screens.name: Audit trail
screens.purpose: Every import, automatic match, resolution and approval for a period, and the export for auditors.
keyContent: Events with time, person or rule and version, and the values compared
Filter by event type
Period and export format

states.description: No events for the period yet
Events couldn't load, or the export failed

screens.name: Matching rules
screens.purpose: Read the rules and tolerances that drive automatic matching, so explanations can be traced back.
keyContent: Each rule with its fields, tolerance and current version
Who can change rules
entryPoints: Rule name in a match explanation

screens.name: Team and roles
screens.purpose: Invite people and give them the Preparer, Reviewer or Finance admin role.
keyContent: People and roles
Invite

assumptions: Exceptions is the home screen because resolving them is most of the work
Matching rules are edited by a finance admin outside the first release; the Matching rules screen is read-only
Roles: Preparer (resolves), Reviewer (approves), Finance admin (rules and team); one person can hold several roles but can't approve their own resolution
One accounting period is worked on at a time, chosen on Exceptions and Import
openQuestions: Should approvals allow batch approval of low-value resolutions, or always one at a time?
Does 'Unmatch and review' need a reason, recorded in the audit trail?
Is a separate close checklist needed, or is 'no open exceptions plus an export' enough to call the period closed?
